scope: Unique git tracked and nonignored untracked working-tree paths. Excludes ignored dependencies/builds/env/local fixtures. Static reachability is a candidate signal, not permission to delete; includes type imports and route entries. No environment values or file contents are recorded.
method: TypeScript AST import/export/require/string-import graph rooted in App Router pages/layouts/routes/loading/error entries and proxy. Config, migration, scripts, tests, CSS, provider internals and dynamic consumers require separate review.
